title: ScienceClaw: Benchmarking Continual Self-Evolution of AI-for-Science Agents Across the Natural and Social Sciences

paragraphs.en: Large language model agents are accelerating scientific automation, yet verified executions rarely become persistent program-level improvements, and existing evaluations do not examine this process across sequential tasks in both the natural and social sciences. We formalize ScienceClaw as fixed-parameter program self-evolution that unifies task solving, scientific verification, and program updates. ScienceClaw-Eval spans 23 disciplines and measures scientific correctness, evolutionary gain, retention, cross-dataset transfer, and evolution cost through sequential streams and independent reset evaluation. Our framework repairs executable workflows through multi-turn interaction, converts re-execution-verified failure–success trajectories into linked Skill and Operator candidates, and retains an update only when source-task replay reproduces the repair and independent scientific tasks improve. Code is available at https://github.com/beita6969/ScienceClaw .
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型智能体正在加速科学自动化，但经过验证的执行结果很少能转化为持久的程序级改进，而现有的评估方法并未在自然科学和社会科学的连续任务中考察这一过程。我们将 ScienceClaw 形式化为一种固定参数程序自我演化机制，它将任务解决、科学验证和程序更新统一了起来。ScienceClaw-Eval 覆盖了 23 个学科，通过连续任务流和独立的重置评估，衡量了科学正确性、演化增益、知识保留能力、跨数据集迁移能力以及演化成本。我们的框架通过多轮交互修复可执行的工作流，将经重新执行验证的失败–成功轨迹转化为相互关联的技能和操作符候选项，并且仅当源任务的重复执行能够重现修复结果且独立的科学任务得到改进时，才会保留更新。代码可在 https://github.com/beita6969/ScienceClaw 获取。

paragraphs.en: Large language model agents are increasingly automating scientific problem solving ( Bran et al., 2023 ; Lu et al., 2024 ) . As illustrated in Figure 1 , they connect natural-language reasoning with data, domain tools, and executable computation to construct end-to-end workflows ( Yao et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) . AI4Science tasks stress this capability through heterogeneous dependencies, long-horizon interactions, and stringent constraints, yet also expose runtime states, numerical diagnostics, and constraint checks that verify intermediate decisions. Scientific agents therefore offer a flexible cross-domain interface beyond fixed scripts and rules. Despite this promise, scientific agents remain limited in continual self-evolution, since repairs rarely persist.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型智能体正日益自动化地解决科学问题（Bran 等，2023；Lu 等，2024）。如图1所示，它们将自然语言推理与数据、领域工具及可执行计算相连接，从而构建端到端的工作流（Yao 等，2022；Wang 等，2024）。AI4Science 任务通过异构依赖关系、长期交互和严格约束凸显了这一能力，但同时也暴露了运行时状态、数值诊断信息和约束检查机制，这些机制可用于验证中间决策。因此，科学智能体提供了一种超越固定脚本和规则的灵活跨领域接口。尽管前景广阔，科学智能体在持续自我演化方面仍存在局限，因为其修复措施很少能够持久生效。

paragraphs.en: Training-based methods improve workflow orchestration and error repair through supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, or separate task optimization, but acquire most improvements before deployment ( Shen et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Agrawal et al., 2026 ) . Training-free methods instead update tools, Skills, control logic, or agent harnesses from execution trajectories ( Lu et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Ni et al., 2026 ; Ling et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Machine, 2025 ) . Scientific efforts, however, remain concentrated on individual tools or Skills ( Lu et al., 2026 ; Team, 2026 ) , while program-level evolution is evaluated mainly in general reasoning, coding, or system-operation environments. No unified setting therefore couples in-task verification of executability and scientific validity, linked Skill–Operator updates, and independent program-level evaluation. Scientific-agent and sequential self-evolution benchmarks do not cover constrained task streams spanning the natural and social sciences ( Shen et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Alizadeh et al., 2026 ) . Thus, task- or component-level gains do not establish reliable and transferable scientific self-evolution across disciplines and rounds.
paragraphs.zh: 基于训练的方法通过监督微调、强化学习或独立任务优化来改进工作流编排和错误修复，但大多数改进都是在部署之前完成的（Shen 等，2026；Zhang 等，2026；Zhao 等，2026；Agrawal 等，2026）。而非训练方法则通过从执行轨迹中更新工具、技能、控制逻辑或智能体框架来实现改进（Lu 等，2026；Yang 等，2026；Ni 等，2026；Ling 等，2026；Lin 等，2026；Shinn 等，2023；Wang 等，2023；Machine，2025）。然而，科学研究仍主要集中在单个工具或技能上（Lu 等，2026；Team，2026），而程序层面的演化则主要在通用推理、编码或系统操作环境中进行评估。因此，目前尚无统一的设置能够将任务内可执行性的验证与科学有效性、技能–操作符的联动更新以及独立的程序层面评估整合在一起。科学智能体及序列自演化基准测试尚未涵盖横跨自然科学与社会科学领域的受限任务流（Shen 等，2026；Liu 等，2026；Xu 等，2026；Jiang 等，2026；Zheng 等，2026；Alizadeh 等，2026）。因此，任务或组件层面的改进，并不能确保跨学科和跨轮次实现可靠且可迁移的科学自演化。

paragraphs.en: This raises a central question: How can verified scientific executions drive persistent and transferable program-level self-evolution without updating foundation-model parameters? We answer it with ScienceClaw, a verifiable AI4Science framework connecting multi-turn workflow orchestration and program-level self-evolution. ScienceClaw represents the editable program as Skills and typed Operators, repairs workflows through execution feedback, and derives linked candidates from re-execution-verified failure–success trajectories. A candidate persists only if source-task replay reproduces the repair and independent scientific tasks improve. Figure 2 summarizes this process. paragraphs.zh: 这引出了一个核心问题：如何在无需更新基础模型参数的情况下，通过可验证的科学执行流程，驱动程序层面持续且可迁移的自我演化？我们通过 ScienceClaw 回答了这一问题。ScienceClaw 是一个可验证的 AI4Science 框架，它将多轮工作流编排与程序层面的自我演化相结合。ScienceClaw 将可编辑的程序表示为“技能”（Skills）和带类型的“操作符”（Operators），通过执行反馈修复工作流，并从经重新执行验证的失败–成功轨迹中推导出关联候选方案。只有当源任务的重复执行能够重现修复过程且独立的科学任务得到改进时，一个候选方案才会被保留。图 2 总结了这一过程。总而言之，我们的三大主要贡献如下：

paragraphs.en: Novel ScienceClaw Task. We formalize program-level self-evolution over sequential AI4Science problems, turning verified executions into persistent and transferable updates without modifying foundation-model parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 新型 ScienceClaw 任务。我们将程序级的自我演化形式化地应用于序列化的 AI4Science 问题，将经过验证的执行过程转化为持久且可迁移的更新，而无需修改基础模型参数。

paragraphs.en: ScienceClaw-Eval. We construct a 23-discipline benchmark across the natural and social sciences with sequential task streams and independent reset evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: ScienceClaw-Eval。我们构建了一个涵盖自然科学与社会科学的 23 个学科基准，包含顺序任务流和独立的重置评估。

paragraphs.en: ScienceClaw Framework. We propose an execution-driven framework coupling multi-turn workflow repair with independently evaluated Skill–Operator updates, allowing scientific capabilities to accumulate across tasks and disciplines without model training.
paragraphs.zh: ScienceClaw 框架。我们提出了一种以执行为导向的框架，将多轮工作流程修复与独立评估的“技能–操作符”更新相结合，使科学能力能够在不同任务和学科中逐步积累，而无需进行模型训练。

paragraphs.en: Scientific Agents and Evaluation. General-purpose LLM agents continue to exhibit limited reliability and generalization in specialized scientific tasks, motivating domain-specific tools, interactive execution environments, and scientific-agent benchmarks ( Shen et al., 2026 ; Alizadeh et al., 2026 ; Tian et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . Evaluation has progressed from static question answering to executable workflows that connect scientific data, domain software, and code execution ( Shen et al., 2026 ; Lupidi et al., 2026 ) . Interactive environments assess multi-step tool use and error recovery ( Wang et al., 2022 ) , while more recent benchmarks extend evaluation to the end-to-end research lifecycle, including idea generation, experiment analysis, and iterative refinement using real papers and data ( Shen et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Lupidi et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Bragg et al., 2026 ) . Discipline-specific benchmarks further examine the computational reproducibility of social-science findings and the physical fidelity of scientific programs ( Alizadeh et al., 2026 ; Zhang and Chen, 2026 ) . ScienceClaw-Eval instead assesses whether agents accumulate and retain capabilities across tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 科学智能体与评估。通用型 LLM 智能体在专业科学任务中持续表现出有限的可靠性和泛化能力，这推动了领域专用工具、交互式执行环境以及科学智能体基准测试的发展（Shen 等，2026；Alizadeh 等，2026；Tian 等，2024；Chen 等，2025）。评估已从静态问答发展为可执行的流程，这些流程能够连接科学数据、领域专用软件和代码执行（Shen 等，2026；Lupidi 等，2026）。交互式环境用于评估多步骤工具使用和错误恢复能力（Wang 等，2022），而较新的基准测试则将评估范围扩展至端到端的研究生命周期，包括利用真实论文和数据进行创意生成、实验分析和迭代优化（Shen 等，2026；Liu 等，2026；Lupidi 等，2026；Xu 等，2026；Bragg 等，2026）。学科专用基准测试进一步检验了社会科学发现的可计算复现性以及科学程序的物理保真度（Alizadeh 等，2026；Zhang 和 Chen，2026）。相比之下，ScienceClaw-Eval 则评估智能体是否能在不同任务中积累并保留其能力。

paragraphs.en: Workflow Orchestration and Agent Self-Evolution. Early LLM agents mainly relied on hand-crafted prompts, static toolsets, or predefined workflows, with tool interfaces and control flow typically fixed before deployment ( Yao et al., 2022 ; Hong et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2023 ) . Automated workflow optimization subsequently introduced execution-guided search and progressive graph editing, while later methods abstract reusable Operators or distill Skills from execution trajectories ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Ni et al., 2026 ; Ding et al., 2026 ) . More recent work evolves tools, Skills, control logic, and agent harnesses without updating foundation-model parameters ( Lu et al., 2026 ; Team, 2026 ; Ling et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Machine, 2025 ) . In parallel, sequential evaluation frameworks measure evolutionary gain, cross-task transfer, retention, and forgetting ( Jiang et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Lopez-Paz and Ranzato, 2017 ) . Although scientific agents begin to evolve tools or Skills, program-level self-evolution has not been evaluated on executable task streams spanning the natural and social sciences, the gap ScienceClaw-Eval targets.
paragraphs.zh: 工作流编排与智能体自演化。早期的 LLM 智能体主要依赖人工设计的提示、静态工具集或预定义的工作流，其工具接口和控制流程通常在部署前就已固定（Yao 等，2022；Hong 等，2024；Wu 等，2023）。随后，自动工作流优化引入了执行引导的搜索和渐进式图编辑方法，而更晚期的方法则通过抽象可重用的操作符或从执行轨迹中提炼技能来实现进化（Zhang 等，2026；Zhao 等，2026；Yang 等，2026；Ni 等，2026；Ding 等，2026）。近期的研究则在不更新基础模型参数的情况下，对工具、技能、控制逻辑和智能体框架进行演化（Lu 等，2026；Team，2026；Ling 等，2026；Lin 等，2026；Shinn 等，2023；Wang 等，2023；Machine，2025）。与此同时，序列评估框架被用于衡量演化增益、跨任务迁移能力、知识保留与遗忘情况（Jiang 等，2026；Zheng 等，2026；Lopez-Paz 和 Ranzato，2017）。尽管科学智能体已开始演化工具或技能，但程序层面的自演化尚未在涵盖自然科学与社会科学的可执行任务流中得到评估，而 ScienceClaw-Eval 正是针对这一差距展开的。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 shows four stages: task collection, executable instantiation, validation, and evaluation partitioning. We collect tasks with explicit objectives, accessible inputs, and verifiable outcomes from public scientific resources, and supplement them to improve disciplinary coverage, workflow diversity, and horizon length while preserving provenance. Each task is instantiated as D t D_{t} with an isolated environment and a task-specific evaluator. Domain reviewers inspect evaluator logic, constraints, and reference executions; reset replay then verifies executability, scientific validity, and reproducibility. Provenance and construction lineage ( Wilkinson et al., 2016 ) determine the source stream 𝒟 src \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{src}} , independent validation set 𝒟 val \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{val}} , held-out ID set 𝒟 ID \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{ID}} , and same-discipline cross-dataset OOD set 𝒟 OOD \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{OOD}} ( Koh et al., 2021 ) . 𝒟 rep \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{rep}} contains frozen source-task instances encountered before each evaluation point, measuring retention without supplying new evolution evidence. Each task record fixes its source, partition rule, evaluator, and statistics before experiments begin.

paragraphs.en: Scientific workflow failures often surface only when heterogeneous data, domain software, and numerical procedures execute. ScienceClaw turns reproducible repairs into linked Skill–Operator updates through execution-guided orchestration (Section 5.1 ) and program self-evolution (Section 5.2 ), with foundation-model parameters fixed. A repair persists only after it reproduces on its source task and improves the complete program on independent tasks, rather than on a single execution trace (Appendix B ).
paragraphs.zh: 科学工作流程中的故障通常仅在异构数据、领域软件和数值程序开始执行时才会显现。ScienceClaw 通过执行引导的协调（第 5.1 节）和程序自我演化（第 5.2 节），将可重复的修复转化为相互关联的“技能–操作者”更新，同时保持基础模型参数固定。一项修复只有在它在源任务上成功复现，并且能够改进独立任务上的完整程序时才会被保留，而不仅仅是基于单一的执行轨迹（附录 B）。

paragraphs.en: Setup. All systems process the common 23-discipline source streams. Evolving methods update their programs, whereas the frozen control remains at A 0 A_{0} . We freeze the snapshot after each of seven rounds, clear transient state, and evaluate it on the held-out same-discipline target datasets in 𝒟 OOD \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{OOD}} ; OOD results never generate or select updates. Qwen3.5-27B orchestrates every task for all systems, GPT-5.4 performs the evolution of ScienceClaw and every baseline, and each discipline contributes 64 IID and 64 OOD instances. We compare ScienceClaw with an evolution-disabled frozen agent and methods that evolve Skills, scientific tools, agent harnesses, or persistent scientific-agent programs and memory: SkillOpt ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , test-time tool evolution (TTE) ( Lu et al., 2026 ) , Agentic Harness Engineering (AHE) ( Lin et al., 2026 ) , EvoMaster ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) , and EvoScientist ( Lyu et al., 2026 ) . Each baseline runs its best released configuration through fixed ScienceClaw-Eval adapters under the same models, tools, source stream, validation data, and update budget (Appendix B.8 ); adapters and initial assets are fixed without access to ID/OOD instances or evaluators. Two ScienceClaw variants complete the comparison: RuleEvo evolves by deterministic trace projection alone, and Qwen-only evolution replaces GPT-5.4 with Qwen. Three PhD reviewers per discipline and a natural- or social-science expert audited each evaluator and its reference executions. Table 1 reports task-native scores, compared only within each discipline because metrics differ in units and direction; round-wise analyses use MacroSR on 𝒟 OOD \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{OOD}} (Eq. ( 4 )) as the OOD macro score.

paragraphs.en: RQ1: Does persistent program evolution improve cross-dataset performance? Yes. ScienceClaw is best in all 23 disciplines on both splits (Table 1 ), and its mean relative margin over the strongest baseline in each discipline grows from 2.58% on IID to 4.19% on OOD (12.25% and 16.45% over the frozen agent), and it is positive in every discipline, from 1.82% to 3.73% on IID and from 3.05% to 6.21% on OOD (Appendix G.1 ). The largest OOD margins appear in Indigenous studies (6.21%) and Law (5.42%), the smallest in Physical sciences (3.05%). The wider OOD margin is consistent with the gate: a candidate persists only after it reproduces on its source task and improves independent validation tasks, which filters out updates fitted to one source, whereas single-asset methods can fall below the frozen agent (SkillOpt in three of 46 cells). The baselines order by how much of the program they evolve: their mean OOD gain over the frozen agent rises from 5.74% for SkillOpt (Skills) through 8.82% for TTE (tools) and 9.73% for AHE (harness) to 10.55% for EvoScientist and 11.95% for EvoMaster (programs and memory), against 16.45% for ScienceClaw, above all of them. ScienceClaw also beats the frozen agent in every discipline, by 11.57% to 23.34% on OOD, and its margin is similar on higher-is-better (4.26%) and lower-is-better metrics (4.06%). Its OOD score falls 11.73% below its IID score on average, against 16.06% for the frozen agent and 13.46% to 15.45% for the baselines, so the evolved program degrades least of all systems when the dataset changes.
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题1：持续的程序演化能否提升跨数据集的性能？答案是肯定的。ScienceClaw在所有23个学科的两个数据分割集上均表现最佳（表1），且其在每个学科中相对于最强基线模型的平均相对优势，从IID上的2.58%增长到OOD上的4.19%（分别比固定智能体高出12.25%和16.45%），并且在所有学科中均为正值：IID上为1.82%至3.73%，OOD上为3.05%至6.21%（附录G.1）。最大的OOD优势出现在原住民研究（6.21%）和法律（5.42%）领域，而最小的则出现在物理科学（3.05%）。更宽的OOD优势与筛选机制一致：候选程序只有在源任务上成功复现并提升独立验证任务后才会被保留，这一机制过滤掉了仅针对单一源任务优化的更新；相比之下，单资产方法的表现甚至可能低于固定智能体（在46个单元格中有3个，SkillOpt的表现低于固定智能体）。基线模型的性能排序与其演化的程序量相关：它们相对于固定智能体的平均OOD增益依次上升，从SkillOpt（技能）的5.74%、TTE（工具）的8.82%、AHE（框架）的9.73%，到EvoScientist的10.55%和EvoMaster（程序与记忆）的11.95%，而ScienceClaw的增益最高，达到16.45%，超过了所有基线模型。此外，ScienceClaw在每个学科中都优于固定智能体，OOD上的优势幅度为11.57%至23.34%；在“越高越好”和“越低越好”两类指标上，其优势幅度也相近（分别为4.26%和4.06%）。当数据集发生变化时，ScienceClaw的OOD得分平均比其IID得分低11.73%，而固定智能体的降幅为16.06%，各基线模型的降幅则在13.46%至15.45%之间。因此，在所有系统中，演化程序在数据集变化时的性能退化程度最低。

paragraphs.en: RQ2: Does evolution keep improving OOD performance over rounds? Yes. ScienceClaw’s OOD macro score rises from 77.72 at A 0 A_{0} to 91.30 after round 7 (+13.59 pp), against +9.78 pp for EvoMaster, the strongest baseline, and its lead over the best other system grows from 0.41 pp after round 1 to 3.80 pp (Figure 6 a,d,e). Round 3 is the only round in which another system leads, by 0.41 pp. From round 3 to round 7 ScienceClaw adds 8.83 pp, nearly twice the 4.6 pp of EvoMaster. The curve keeps rising because ScienceClaw promotes more candidates than any other system, 70 of the 161 submitted (43.48% against 22.98% to 39.13%; Figure 6 i), so the gate is selective without stalling. RuleEvo and Qwen-only, which change only how candidates are produced, reach +3.60 and +5.50 pp, so candidate quality, not the gate alone, drives the gain. None of the five evolving systems dips by more than 0.34 pp in any round.
paragraphs.zh: RQ2：进化过程是否会在各轮中持续提升 OOD 性能？是的。ScienceClaw 的 OOD 宏观得分从 A 0 A_{0} 时的 77.72 提升至第 7 轮后的 91.30（+13.59 pp），而最强的基线模型 EvoMaster 仅提升了 +9.78 pp；ScienceClaw 相对于其他最佳系统的领先优势也从第 1 轮后的 0.41 pp 扩大到 3.80 pp（图 6 a,d,e）。第 3 轮是唯一一个其他系统以 0.41 pp 的差距领先的轮次。从第 3 轮到第 7 轮，ScienceClaw 的得分增加了 8.83 pp，几乎是 EvoMaster 所增加 4.6 pp 的两倍。其得分曲线持续上升，是因为 ScienceClaw 比其他任何系统都更多地推广了候选模型：在提交的 161 个模型中，有 70 个被选中（占比 43.48%，而其他系统的比例在 22.98% 到 39.13% 之间；图 6 i），因此筛选机制既具选择性又未造成停滞。仅改变候选模型生成方式的 RuleEvo 和 Qwen-only 分别提升了 +3.60 pp 和 +5.50 pp，这表明候选模型的质量而非仅靠筛选机制本身才是性能提升的关键。在五个进化系统中，没有任何一个在任何一轮中的得分下降超过 0.34 pp。

paragraphs.en: RQ3: Does evolution transfer across disciplines and retain earlier repairs? Yes. Evolving on one discipline family lifts the OOD score of the others: 18 of the 20 cross-family pairs are positive, with a mean gain of 1.58 pp against 14.69 pp within a family (Figure 6 b), so most of the evolved capability is discipline specific and the part that transfers rarely harms. Transfer is strongest between related families: Social/behavioural and Humanities/law (+4.27, +3.61), and Engineering/computing and Physical/Earth (+3.54, +3.47). The two negative pairs, both between Physical/Earth and Humanities/law, stay below 0.6 pp in magnitude. Retention shows the same pattern (Figure 6 c; Appendix G.3 ): ScienceClaw reaches 4.20 pp forward (all 25 pairs) and 3.66 pp backward transfer with 0.13 pp average and 0.51 pp maximum forgetting and 11.89% negative transfer, against 0.33 pp, 1.05 pp, and 14.33% for EvoMaster. Source replay protects earlier repairs, and independent validation guards the other families against regressions.
paragraphs.zh: RQ3：演化能力是否能在不同学科间迁移，并保留早期的修复成果？答案是肯定的。在一个学科家族中进行演化，能够提升其他学科家族的 OOD 分数：20 个跨家族配对中有 18 个为正值，平均增益为 1.58 pp，而同一家族内的平均增益为 14.69 pp（图 6b）。因此，演化出的能力大多具有学科特异性，而能够迁移的部分很少造成负面影响。迁移效果在相关学科家族之间最为显著：社会/行为科学与人文/法律（+4.27、+3.61），以及工程/计算机科学与物理/地球科学（+3.54、+3.47）。两个负值配对均出现在物理/地球科学与人文/法律之间，其绝对值均未超过 0.6 pp。能力保留情况也呈现出相同模式（图 6c；附录 G.3）：ScienceClaw 的前向迁移能力达到 4.20 pp（全部 25 个配对），后向迁移能力为 3.66 pp，平均遗忘量为 0.13 pp，最大遗忘量为 0.51 pp，负向迁移率为 11.83%；而 EvoMaster 的对应数据分别为 0.33 pp、1.05 pp 和 14.33%。源数据重播机制能够保护早期的修复成果，而独立验证则能防止其他学科家族出现性能退化。

paragraphs.en: RQ4: Which mechanisms produce the gain? The linked evolution and the replay gate. The full system is best in all 23 disciplines (Table 2 ; Appendices B.7 and G.2 ), and every ablation keeps only part of its gain over the frozen agent, with gain measured as the average relative drop below the full system (13.68% for Frozen; Appendix F.3 ). Updating Skills and Operators without committing them as one bundle keeps 60% of the gain, a loss comparable to removing Operator evolution (59%); on Commerce and Law the linked system gains 14.69% and 19.82% on OOD over Frozen, against 9.27% and 13.12% unlinked (Figure 6 f). The gate matters even more: without IID selection only 15% of the gain remains, and without scientific constraints, source replay, or the independent validator, 46%, 55%, and 59%, with losses 2.4 to 2.8 times larger on OOD than on IID. RuleEvo and Qwen-only keep only about a third and 44%. In 20 of 23 disciplines the runner-up to the full system removes a single evolution component, so no component carries the gain alone. Execution structure is the base on which evolution acts: single-turn and single-operator execution fall below the frozen agent (Figure 2 ), and Linked Full runs 4.84 planner rounds and 4.24 distinct Operators per task, repairs 71% of failures from feedback, recovers 89% after interruption, and replays 96% cleanly, against 0, 31%, and 78% for a single-turn agent (Figure 6 g; case studies of Commerce and Law in Appendix E ).
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题4：哪些机制产生了这种增益？答案是“关联演化”和“重播门”。完整系统在全部23个学科中表现最佳（表2；附录B.7和G.2），而任何消融实验都仅能保留部分相对于冻结智能体的增益，其中增益以低于完整系统的平均相对降幅来衡量（冻结智能体为13.68%；附录F.3）。如果不将“技能更新”和“算子更新”作为一个捆绑包进行提交，则只能保留60%的增益，这一损失与移除算子演化（59%）相当。在商业和法律学科中，关联系统在OOD场景下相对于冻结智能体的增益分别为14.69%和19.82%，而非关联系统则为9.27%和13.12%（图6f）。重播门的作用更为关键：若没有IID选择，仅能保留15%的增益；若缺少科学约束、源重播或独立验证器，则分别只能保留46%、55%和59%，且OOD场景下的损失是IID场景下的2.4至2.8倍。仅使用RuleEvo或Qwen的系统分别只能保留约三分之一和44%的增益。在23个学科中的20个学科里，仅次于完整系统的方案都移除了单个演化组件，因此没有任何一个组件能单独带来全部增益。执行结构是演化作用的基础：单轮次和单算子执行的表现均低于冻结智能体（图2）。而“关联完整系统”每任务平均运行4.84轮规划器、使用4.24个不同算子，能够根据反馈修复71%的失败，在中断后恢复89%，并以96%的准确率完成重播；相比之下，单轮次智能体在这些指标上分别为0、31%和78%（图6g；商业和法律学科的案例研究见附录E）。

paragraphs.en: RQ5: Is the gain reliable and efficient? Yes. ScienceClaw passes the hard constraints on 98.23% of instances, 2.58 points above EvoMaster, makes the fewest erroneous promotions in Figure 6 c (1.23% against 3.80% to 7.25%), and costs less per OOD point than every other method (1.37 to 2.50 times as much, 27.1% less than EvoMaster), while its planner takes the smallest share of wall-clock time (18.40%; Figure 6 h; Appendix G.3 ). Every compared evolving method passes more constraints than the frozen agent (91.51%), and ScienceClaw adds the most (+6.73 points). Its target attainment of 96.42% is 1.43 points above EvoMaster and 7.85 above the frozen agent (88.57%). The replay and validation that block invalid updates therefore do not trade against cost. Appendix F.8 gives the cost accounting behind these ratios, and Appendix G.3 defines the reliability metrics.
paragraphs.zh: RQ5：这种增益是否可靠且高效？是的。ScienceClaw 在 98.23% 的实例中通过了严格的约束条件，比 EvoMaster 高出 2.58 分；在图 6c 中，其错误提升的次数最少（1.23%，而其他方法为 3.80% 至 7.25%）；并且每 OOD 点的成本低于所有其他方法（后者的成本是 ScienceClaw 的 1.37 至 2.50 倍，比 EvoMaster 低 27.1%），同时其规划器占用的实际运行时间比例最小（18.40%；图 6h；附录 G.3）。所有被比较的演化方法通过的约束条件数量都多于冻结智能体（91.51%），而 ScienceClaw 增加的约束条件数量最多（+6.73 分）。其目标达成率为 96.42%，比 EvoMaster 高 1.43 分，比冻结智能体（88.57%）高 7.85 分。因此，阻止无效更新的回放和验证步骤并未以成本为代价。附录 F.8 提供了这些比率背后的成本计算，附录 G.3 则定义了可靠性指标。

paragraphs.en: Across 23 disciplines, ScienceClaw’s replay-gated linked Skill–Operator evolution yields sustained OOD gains, positive cross-family transfer, and stronger retention at a lower cost per gain, without updating any model parameters. These results support evaluating scientific-agent evolution by persistence, transfer, validity, and reproducibility, rather than isolated task scores. ScienceClaw-Eval measures scientific correctness, evolutionary gain, retention, cross-dataset transfer, and evolution cost through sequential streams and independent reset evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 在23个学科中，ScienceClaw通过重播门控的“技能–操作符”联合演化，实现了持续的域外（OOD）性能提升、积极的跨家族迁移能力，以及以更低的每次提升成本获得更强的性能保持能力，且无需更新任何模型参数。这些结果支持通过持续性、迁移性、有效性和可重复性来评估科学智能体的演化，而非仅依赖孤立的任务得分。ScienceClaw-Eval通过序列流和独立的重置评估，衡量了科学正确性、演化增益、性能保持、跨数据集迁移能力以及演化成本。

paragraphs.en: Automated evaluators may miss domain errors (Appendix D ), and updates may transfer incorrectly. ScienceClaw should support, not replace, experts; high-stakes use requires provenance, licensing, privacy safeguards, and independent review. The 23-discipline scope and cross-dataset splits do not eliminate shared conventions or within-field variation. Reported trajectories are final snapshots, so broader claims need repeated runs and discipline-level intervals. Persistent executable updates can reuse errors and expand the attack surface, requiring versioned program snapshots, replay and rollback, sandboxing, least-privilege credentials, auditable provenance, and human approval for irreversible actions.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化评估器可能会遗漏领域错误（附录 D），且更新过程也可能出现错误传输。ScienceClaw 应支持专家，而非取代专家；高风险应用需要来源追溯、许可授权、隐私保护机制以及独立审查。23 个学科的范围和跨数据集的划分并不能消除共享的惯例或学科内部的差异。所报告的轨迹是最终快照，因此更广泛的结论需要通过重复运行和按学科划分的区间分析来验证。持续执行的更新可能会重复利用错误并扩大攻击面，因此需要版本化的程序快照、重播与回滚机制、沙盒隔离、最小权限凭证、可审计的来源追溯，以及对不可逆操作的人工批准。

paragraphs.en: Let G G be a DAG and U U a nonempty node set. The graph G / U G/U , obtained by contracting U U into one node, is acyclic iff U U is convex.
paragraphs.zh: 设 G 是一个有向无环图（DAG），U 是一个非空节点集。通过将 U 中的所有节点合并为一个节点而得到的图 G / U 是无环的，当且仅当 U 是凸集。

paragraphs.en: ( ⇐ \Leftarrow ) A cycle in G / U G/U cannot avoid the contracted node, since G G is acyclic. It lifts to a path in G G that leaves U U at some v ∈ U v\in U through nodes outside U U and returns to some w ∈ U w\in U . If v ≠ w v\neq w this contradicts convexity; if v = w v=w it is a cycle in G G . ( ⇒ \Rightarrow ) If U U is not convex, some path between nodes of U U contains a maximal outside segment x 1 , … , x k x_{1},\dots,x_{k} entered from a ∈ U a\in U and left toward b ∈ U b\in U . Then U → x 1 → … → x k → U U\to x_{1}\to\dots\to x_{k}\to U is a cycle in G / U G/U . ∎
paragraphs.zh: ( ⇐ \Leftarrow ) G / U 中的循环无法避开收缩节点，因为 G 是无环的。它提升为 G 中的一条路径，该路径从 U 中某个 v ∈ U 出发，经过 U 外的节点，然后返回到 U 中的某个 w ∈ U。若 v ≠ w，这与凸性矛盾；若 v = w，则它构成 G 中的一个循环。( ⇒ \Rightarrow ) 如果 U 不是凸的，那么 U 中某些节点之间的一条路径会包含一个最大的外部段 x₁, …, xₖ，该段从 a ∈ U 进入，并向 b ∈ U 离开。此时，U → x₁ → … → xₖ → U 构成 G / U 中的一个循环。∎

paragraphs.en: The persisted program is monotone in recorded validation value, feasible at every promotion, selected without access to the held-out splits, and built from components that reproduce the evidence they came from. The noise guard lowers false promotion at a cost in power, and operator replacement preserves acyclicity.
paragraphs.zh: 持久化的程序在已记录的验证值上是单调的，在每次提升时都是可行的，且无需访问预留的数据分割即可被选中；它由能够重现其来源证据的组件构建而成。噪声防护机制以降低统计功效为代价来减少错误提升，而算子替换则能保持无环性。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 maps each object to its module. Every run writes receipts: the resolved configuration, each program snapshot A r A_{r} , and, per episode, the trajectory, the final graph, the output, and the evaluation record, together with a ledger of tokens and wall time per phase.
paragraphs.zh: 表 3 将每个对象与其模块进行映射。每次运行都会生成记录：已解析的配置、每个程序快照 A r A_{r}，以及每集成的轨迹、最终图、输出和评估记录，同时还包括各阶段的令牌消耗和实际运行时间账本。

paragraphs.en: A node is a tool call into the task’s visible tools 𝒯 t \mathcal{T}_{t} , a code node holding a Python function of its inputs and configuration, an llm node that maps a prompt template over a list of items, an operator node that expands a registered Operator, or the single submit node whose input is the required output y t y_{t} . A port schema Γ \Gamma has a type (any, number, text, array, table, list, dict, series), a shape (integers or named symbols), a unit, and provenance. An edge is valid when the types agree or one is any , the shapes unify with symbols bound consistently, and the units are equal, unspecified on either side, or bridged by an explicit conversion (a factor and an offset) attached to the edge, which is recorded in provenance. A graph is valid when it is acyclic, all ports exist, every edge is compatible, and it has at most one submit node.
paragraphs.zh: 节点是一种工具调用，指向任务中可见的工具 𝒯 t \mathcal{T}_{t}；也可以是包含其输入和配置的一个 Python 函数的代码节点、将提示模板映射到项目列表上的 llm 节点、展开已注册操作符的操作符节点，或者其输入为所需输出 y t y_{t} 的唯一提交节点。端口模式 Γ \Gamma 具有类型（任意、数字、文本、数组、表格、列表、字典、序列）、形状（整数或命名符号）、单位和来源。当类型一致或其中一方为“任意”，形状通过一致绑定的符号实现统一，且单位相等（在任一侧未指定）或由附加到该边上的显式转换（一个因子和一个偏移量）连接时，一条边是有效的，这些转换会记录在来源中。当一个图是无环的、所有端口都存在、每条边都是兼容的，并且最多只有一个提交节点时，该图是有效的。

paragraphs.en: Each node has a fingerprint, the hash of its specification, its upstream fingerprints, and its edge wiring. The checkpoint χ \chi maps fingerprints to recorded outputs. After an edit only nodes whose fingerprint is absent from χ \chi run again, in topological order, so an edit to one node recomputes its descendants and nothing else. A node whose outcome is not reproducible, such as a failed language-model call or a first timeout, is marked transient, and neither it nor any descendant enters the checkpoint.
paragraphs.zh: 每个节点都有一个指纹，即其规格、上游指纹和边连接关系的哈希值。检查点 χ \chi 将指纹映射到已记录的输出。编辑后，只有那些指纹不在 χ \chi 中的节点才会按拓扑顺序重新运行，因此对一个节点的编辑只会重新计算其后代节点，而不会影响其他任何节点。如果某个节点的结果无法重现（例如语言模型调用失败或首次超时），则该节点会被标记为临时状态，且它及其任何后代都不会被纳入检查点。

paragraphs.en: Code nodes run in a separate process with their own working directory and a time limit, and tool nodes run in trusted adapter code under one lock. A node has a limit of max ⁡ _ ​ n ​ o ​ d ​ e ​ _ ​ s \max\_node\_s seconds, and an operator node as a whole has twice that limit. Hidden labels never enter the run environment: adapters keep them inside the evaluator. A static scan of code nodes rejects absolute paths and directory traversal, references to the dataset root and to the evaluator package, network, download, and process-spawning modules, dynamic evaluation and imports, and environment or credential access; its violations feed the integrity check in 𝐇 val \mathbf{H}_{\mathrm{val}} , and the worker runs with a scrubbed environment.
paragraphs.zh: 代码节点在独立的进程中运行，拥有自己的工作目录和时间限制；工具节点则在受信任的适配器代码中运行，并处于单一锁的保护之下。单个节点的最大运行时间为 max⁡_​n​o​d​e​_​s \max\_node\_s 秒，而一个操作符节点整体的时间限制则是该值的两倍。隐藏标签绝不会进入运行环境：适配器会将它们保留在评估器内部。对代码节点的静态扫描会拒绝绝对路径和目录遍历、对数据集根目录和评估器包的引用、网络、下载和进程创建模块、动态评估与导入，以及对环境或凭证的访问；任何违规行为都会输入到 𝐇 val \mathbf{H}_{\mathrm{val}} 的完整性检查中，且工作进程将在经过清理的环境中运行。

paragraphs.en: After each execution the executor returns per-node status and error text, output summaries (type, shape, unit, fraction of finite values, range, head), violated contract conditions, the visible constraint checks on the submit output, and the visible development score when the task provides one. These fields form f t , k f_{t,k} in Eq. ( 7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 每次执行后，执行器都会返回每个节点的状态和错误信息、输出摘要（类型、形状、单位、有限值的比例、范围、头部）、被违反的合同条件、提交输出上的可见约束检查，以及任务提供时的可见开发分数。这些字段构成了公式 (7) 中的 f t , k f_{t,k}。

paragraphs.en: Replay executes the complete graph in a fresh run directory with an empty checkpoint. A result is reproducible when the replayed output matches the executor’s output within the episode tolerance. A clean replay runs whenever a submit output differs in fingerprint from the last replayed one, and the sequence of replays gives the evidence e t , k e_{t,k} .
paragraphs.zh: 重播会在一个空的检查点的新运行目录中执行完整的图。当重播的输出在剧集容限内与执行器的输出相匹配时，结果即可复现。每当提交的输出指纹与上次重播的结果不同时，就会执行一次干净的重播，而一系列重播则提供了证据 e t , k e_{t,k} 。

paragraphs.en: At each turn the policy emits one JSON object with a short rationale, one action, and the identifiers ν t , k \nu_{t,k} of the Skills and Operators it used. The actions are add_node , remove_node , modify_node (with a patch to code, a find-and-replace code edit, prompt, configuration, ports, or wiring), add_edge , remove_edge , and finish . A rejected action leaves the graph unchanged and returns the reason as feedback. Edits that change only configuration, edges, node removal, or add tool, operator, or submit nodes are control edits ( Π ctrl \Pi_{\mathrm{ctrl}} ), and edits that add or modify code or prompt nodes are executable edits ( Π exec \Pi_{\mathrm{exec}} ).
paragraphs.zh: 在每个回合中，策略都会输出一个 JSON 对象，其中包含简短的推理说明、一个操作，以及其所使用的技能和操作符的标识符 ν t , k \nu_{t,k}。操作包括 add_node（添加节点）、remove_node（删除节点）、modify_node（修改节点，具体形式为代码补丁、查找替换式代码编辑、提示词、配置、端口或布线）、add_edge（添加边）、remove_edge（删除边）以及 finish（结束）。被拒绝的操作会使图保持不变，并以反馈形式返回原因。仅更改配置、边、删除节点，或添加工具、操作符或提交节点的操作属于控制类操作（Π ctrl \Pi_{\mathrm{ctrl}}），而添加或修改代码或提示词节点的操作则属于可执行操作（Π exec \Pi_{\mathrm{exec}}）。

paragraphs.en: The system prompt describes what each action, node kind, and interface rule does, the deliverable format, and a uniform acceptance statement: a deliverable counts as solved when the task metric beats the task’s reference by a fixed margin, all constraints hold, and the final workflow replays reproducibly within the budget. It names no metric value, reference method, or task-specific recipe. The initial program A 0 A_{0} is empty; strategies reach the prompt only as retrieved Skills, and the prompt is scanned for strategy phrases to keep it so. Each turn adds the objective, the tool signatures with port descriptions, the retrieved Skills and Operators, the remaining budget, the feedback of the last step, and a compact history of earlier steps. The policy never sees hidden-label scores.
paragraphs.zh: 系统提示描述了每个动作、节点类型和接口规则的作用、交付成果格式以及统一的接受声明：当任务指标以固定幅度优于任务的参考值、所有约束条件均满足，且最终工作流能在预算范围内可重复地重演时，该交付成果即被视为完成。提示中未提及任何指标值、参考方法或任务特定的方案。初始程序 A 0 A_{0} 为空；策略仅以检索到的技能形式进入提示，而提示本身也会扫描策略短语以保持这种状态。每个回合都会添加目标、带有端口描述的工具签名、检索到的技能和操作符、剩余预算、上一步的反馈以及早期步骤的简要历史记录。策略永远不会看到隐藏标签的分数。

paragraphs.en: Skills and Operators are ranked against the episode query (objective, task type, tags, discipline, and required-output type) by a lexical Okapi BM25 over their text, plus bonuses for matching discipline, task type, tags, and, for Operators, input port types. A component is retrievable only if it matches the episode by metadata or covers at least 15% of the query’s inverse-document frequency mass; ranking is deterministic, and the top 4 Skills and top 6 Operators enter the context. A Skill or Operator learned in one discipline stays retrievable in another when it is relevant to the episode, which is how cross-discipline transfer arises. The hash of the retrieved version identifiers and content digests is the retrieval slice of an episode, and a candidate is validated on an episode only when it changes that slice (Section B.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 技能和操作符会根据其文本与剧集查询（目标、任务类型、标签、学科及所需输出类型）进行基于词表的 Okapi BM25 排名，同时还会因匹配学科、任务类型、标签以及操作符的输入端口类型而获得加分。只有当某个组件通过元数据与剧集匹配，或覆盖了查询逆文档频率质量的至少 15% 时，它才可被检索到。排名是确定性的，且排名前 4 的技能和前 6 个操作符会进入上下文。在某一学科中学到的技能或操作符，只要其与剧集相关，就能在另一学科中保持可检索性，这就是跨学科迁移的机制。所检索版本标识符和内容摘要的哈希值构成了剧集的检索切片，而候选项只有在改变该切片时才会被用于验证（参见 B.5 节）。

paragraphs.en: One round processes one source episode per discipline in a fixed source order, so seven rounds give 7 × 23 = 161 7\times 23=161 source episodes and 161 candidates per method. The default schedule is per candidate: each candidate is validated immediately against the current incumbent, and the next source episode already uses the updated program. Snapshots A 0 , … , A 7 A_{0},\dots,A_{7} are taken at round ends.
paragraphs.zh: 每一轮按固定的源顺序处理每个学科的一个源事例，因此七轮共产生 7 × 23 = 161 个源事例和每种方法下的 161 个候选者。默认时间表以每个候选者为单位：每个候选者会立即与当前的在位者进行验证，而下一个源事例则会直接使用更新后的程序。快照 A₀, … , A₇ 在各轮结束时记录。

paragraphs.en: Solve the source episode with A r A_{r} in source mode, which stops at the first replay-verified pass. The final workflow is the replay-verified passing graph with the best visible development score.
paragraphs.zh: 以源模式使用 A r A_{r} 解决源集，该过程会在首次通过重播验证时停止。最终的工作流是具有最佳可见发展分数的重播验证通过图。

paragraphs.en: Extract the evolution instance. The pass is e i + e_{i}^{+} , the latest replay-verified failure before it is e i − e_{i}^{-} (or none), and the actions between them form δ i \delta_{i} (Eq. ( 9 )). Without e i − e_{i}^{-} , only an Operator candidate is formed.
paragraphs.zh: 提取演化实例。该过程为 e i + e_{i}^{+}，其之前最近一次经重演验证的失败为 e i − e_{i}^{-}（或不存在），而两者之间的动作构成 δ i \delta_{i}（公式 (9)）。如果没有 e i − e_{i}^{-}，则仅能形成一个操作符候选。

paragraphs.en: Split the repair. Control edits give Δ i 𝒮 \Delta_{i}^{\mathcal{S}} . Executable nodes created or modified in δ i \delta_{i} , together with the executable nodes weakly connected to them, are grouped into maximal connected components that are made convex by splitting along a topological cut (Lemma A.14 ). Nodes expanded from a registered Operator are not candidates unless δ i \delta_{i} touched them.
paragraphs.zh: 拆分该修复。控制编辑产生 Δ i 𝒮 \Delta_{i}^{\mathcal{S}} 。在 δ i \delta_{i} 中创建或修改的可执行节点，以及与之弱连接的可执行节点，被分组为最大连通分量，这些分量通过沿拓扑切分进行拆分而变为凸的（引理 A.14）。除非 δ i \delta_{i} 触及了它们，否则由已注册的操作符展开的节点不是候选项。

paragraphs.en: Form candidates. The Skill candidate patches the attributed Skills, or creates one if none was attributed, from the control edits and the failure and success evidence, without instance-specific values or answers. Each component becomes an Operator candidate: its body is the subgraph, concrete integer dimensions at its boundary are replaced by symbols so that instance sizes do not make it incompatible with other episodes, its contract κ \kappa records the types, shapes, units, finiteness, and ranges observed at the boundary together with episode tags, and its provenance records episode, steps, and parent program version. Names and descriptions are documentation only.
paragraphs.zh: 生成候选者。技能候选者会根据控制性编辑以及失败和成功证据，补全已分配的技能；若未分配任何技能，则创建一个新技能，且不包含实例特定的值或答案。每个组件都会成为一个操作符候选者：其主体为子图，边界处的具体整数维度会被符号替代，以确保实例大小不会导致其与其他事件不兼容；其契约 κ \kappa 记录了在边界处观察到的类型、形状、单位、有限性和范围，以及事件标签；其来源则记录了事件、步骤和父程序版本。名称和描述仅用于文档说明。

paragraphs.en: Boundary replay. Recorded inputs at ∂ − U \partial^{-}U are loaded, the Operator runs in isolation in a fresh directory, and its outputs at ∂ + U \partial^{+}U are compared with τ i + \tau_{i}^{+} within tolerance. Only passing Operators enter the bundle B i B_{i} .
paragraphs.zh: 边界重演。在 ∂ − U \partial^{-}U 处记录好的输入会被加载，操作符将在一个全新的目录中独立运行，其在 ∂ + U \partial^{+}U 处的输出会与 τ i + \tau_{i}^{+} 在容限范围内进行比较。只有通过测试的操作符才能进入捆绑包 B i B_{i}。

paragraphs.en: Apply and check the source. The bundle is applied atomically, assigning version identifiers ω i \omega_{i} , and the source episode is solved again from a reset state. R src = 1 R_{\mathrm{src}}=1 requires a passing replay-verified result and that every new version was used: an Operator version is used if an operator node with that reference is in the evidence graph and ran successfully, and a Skill version is used if it is in ν \nu of an applied step up to the evidence step. Citations in rejected or failed actions do not count.
paragraphs.zh: 应用并检查源。该捆绑包以原子方式应用，分配版本标识符 ω i \omega_{i}，并且源剧集会从重置状态重新开始求解。R src = 1 R_{\mathrm{src}}=1 要求通过重播验证的结果，且每个新版本都必须被使用：如果证据图中存在具有该引用的操作符节点且其运行成功，则使用操作符版本；如果该节点位于已应用步骤（直至证据步骤）的 ν \nu 中，则使用技能版本。被拒绝或失败的动作中的引用不计入统计。

paragraphs.en: Gate. The candidate is evaluated on the validation episodes and admitted under the rules of Section B.5 ; otherwise the incumbent is kept.
paragraphs.zh: 关卡。候选智能体将在验证回合中接受评估，并根据 B.5 节的规则决定是否录取；否则，将保留现任智能体。

paragraphs.en: Q val Q_{\mathrm{val}} is MacroSR on 𝒟 val \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{val}} with ties broken by the mean normalized score, so a candidate that solves the same episodes but solves them measurably better can be admitted (Eq. ( A.1 )). 𝐇 val \mathbf{H}_{\mathrm{val}} collects (a) no leakage or sandbox violation, (b) a valid output schema, and (c) no hard-constraint violation that the incumbent did not show. An episode that produced no output is already penalized by MacroSR and has no output to violate a constraint with, so it cannot veto a candidate through 𝐇 val \mathbf{H}_{\mathrm{val}} ; a solver or gateway error does block admission.
paragraphs.zh: Q val Q_{\mathrm{val}} 是 MacroSR 在 𝒟 val \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{val}} 上的应用，当出现平局时以归一化平均分数作为破平标准，因此，一个能够解决相同剧集且解决效果明显更优的候选智能体可以被接纳（公式 (A.1)）。𝐇 val \mathbf{H}_{\mathrm{val}} 收集以下情况：(a) 无数据泄露或沙盒违规；(b) 有效的输出模式；以及 (c) 未出现当前模型未曾出现的硬性约束违规。未产生任何输出的剧集已被 MacroSR 惩罚，且没有输出可用于违反约束，因此它无法通过 𝐇 val \mathbf{H}_{\mathrm{val}} 否决某个候选智能体；但求解器或网关错误则会阻止其被接纳。

paragraphs.en: Eq. ( A.2 ) makes 𝐁 \mathbf{B} concrete: tokens are logical (spent plus cached) so that a run served from the response cache is judged like the original run, and wall time is checked against its own budget. The violated condition is recorded with each rejected candidate.
paragraphs.zh: 公式 (A.2) 使 𝐁 \mathbf{B} 具体化：令牌是逻辑上的（已使用加上已缓存的），因此从响应缓存中提供的运行会被像原始运行一样判断，并且其实际运行时间会与其自身预算进行比较。每个被拒绝的候选项都会记录其违反的条件。

paragraphs.en: A validation episode is solved again only if the candidate changes its retrieval slice, and otherwise the incumbent’s recorded result is reused. The number of re-solved and reused episodes is recorded per candidate, so the validation cost grows with the candidate rather than with the library.
paragraphs.zh: 只有当候选智能体更改其检索切片时，验证回合才会被重新解决；否则，将重复使用当前最优智能体所记录的结果。每个候选智能体的重新解决和重复使用的回合数量都会被单独记录，因此验证成本会随着候选智能体的数量增加而增长，而非随着库的大小增长。

paragraphs.en: With one stochastic solve per validation episode and two validation episodes per discipline, one lucky episode would admit a candidate under the literal rule. The implementation therefore requires the gain to be supported by at least two episodes that individually improved (the episode solves where it failed, or solves with a normalized-score gain of at least ε \varepsilon ) and by at most one that regressed, comparing the entries already recorded and drawing no extra samples (Proposition A.9 ). Setting the first threshold to one restores the literal rule.
paragraphs.zh: 每个验证回合进行一次随机求解，且每个学科有两个验证回合，因此只要有一个幸运的回合，候选者就能根据字面规则被接纳。因此，该实现要求收益必须由至少两个分别取得改进的回合（即成功求解的回合，或归一化得分增益至少为 ε \varepsilon 的求解回合）所支持，且最多只能有一个退步的回合；同时需要比较已记录的条目，而不抽取额外样本（命题 A.9）。将第一个阈值设为一即可恢复字面规则。

paragraphs.en: A solve cut short by a gateway outage is retried with doubling backoff, then becomes an error entry that blocks admission and is never reused. A source solve is retried in the same way and, if it still fails, deferred once to the end of its round. Outages are recorded and are never scored as task failures.
paragraphs.zh: 因网关中断而提前终止的求解会采用指数退避策略重试，随后变为错误条目，阻止准入且永不重复使用。源端求解也会以相同方式重试；如果仍然失败，则会被推迟一次至其回合的末尾。中断事件会被记录，但绝不会被计为任务失败。

paragraphs.en: This appendix documents how ScienceClaw-Eval is built and scored: task sources, partition rules, evaluator definitions, acceptance criteria, hard constraints, budgets, and the checks that keep evaluation honest. Per-discipline values are in Tables 10 and 11 .
paragraphs.zh: 本附录记录了 ScienceClaw-Eval 的构建与评分方法：任务来源、划分规则、评估器定义、接受标准、硬性约束、预算，以及确保评估公正性的检查机制。各学科的具体数值见第 10 表和第 11 表。

paragraphs.en: Construction follows the four stages of Figure 4 .
paragraphs.zh: 构建过程遵循图4中的四个阶段。

paragraphs.en: Each of the 23 disciplines is one division of the ANZSRC 2020 Fields of Research (divisions 30 to 52), and its task is built on a public scientific resource with explicit inputs, a verifiable target, and a recorded license. Every resource is pinned to a version, release, or commit, and its files are checked against recorded checksums when the benchmark loads.
paragraphs.zh: 23 个学科中的每一个都是 ANZSRC 2020 研究领域的其中一个分支（第 30 至 52 分支），其任务基于一个公开的科研资源，该资源具有明确的输入、可验证的目标和已记录的许可。每个资源都绑定到一个特定版本、发布或提交上，并且在基准加载时，其文件会与已记录的校验和进行比对。

paragraphs.en: A task adapter turns the resource into an episode D t = ( D T , D V , D E ) D_{t}=(D_{T},D_{V},D_{E}) . D T D_{T} is the objective and the required output with its schema. D E D_{E} is the execution environment: visible training and development data, the scientific tools of the task, and, where the discipline has one, a domain library of documented functions. D V D_{V} is the evaluator, its hard constraints, and its acceptance rule. An episode contains 16 16 evaluation items, so a split of four episodes holds 64 64 instances.
paragraphs.zh: 任务适配器将资源转换为一个流程 D t = ( D T , D V , D E ) D_{t}=(D_{T},D_{V},D_{E})。其中，D T D_{T} 是目标及其所需输出和对应的模式定义。D E D_{E} 是执行环境：包括可见的训练数据和开发数据、任务所需的科学工具，以及如果该学科存在的话，一个包含已文档化函数的领域库。D V D_{V} 是评估器，包括其硬性约束和接受规则。一个流程包含 16 个评估项，因此由四个流程组成的分割集共包含 64 个实例。

paragraphs.en: Domain reviewers inspect each evaluator, its constraints, and its reference execution (Appendix D ). Reset replay then confirms that a reference solution executes, scores as expected, and reproduces.
paragraphs.zh: 领域评审员会检查每个评估器、其约束条件以及其参考执行过程（附录 D）。随后，重置重播将确认参考解决方案能够执行、获得预期分数并成功重现。

paragraphs.en: Partitions are fixed before any run, drawn with a seeded permutation that is stable in the number of episodes, and written to manifests that are hashed and verified on every load. Items inside an episode are drawn without replacement, and no item is reused across episodes of a held-out split.
paragraphs.zh: 分区在任何运行之前都已固定，通过一个在集数数量上保持稳定的种子排列进行划分，并写入到在每次加载时都会进行哈希和验证的清单中。同一集内的项目是无放回抽取的，并且在预留分割中的不同集之间不会重复使用任何项目。

paragraphs.en: For instance i i , z i ​ ( A r ) = 1 z_{i}(A_{r})=1 iff the run completes within budget, the task-native metric meets the acceptance rule, every hard constraint holds, and the workflow replays reproducibly (Section 4.2 ). The task-native metric is evaluated for each instance, and the acceptance rule compares it with a reference predictor.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，i i , z i ​ ( A r ) = 1 z_{i}(A_{r})=1 当且仅当：运行在预算范围内完成、任务原生指标满足接受规则、所有硬性约束均成立，并且工作流能够可重复地重演（第 4.2 节）。任务原生指标针对每个实例进行评估，而接受规则则将其与一个参考预测器进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Every task has a deterministic reference predictor computed from the visible data of the same episode (Table 10 ). The acceptance rule is the metric beats the reference by a fixed margin , either additive or multiplicative, and the margin is fixed per task before any run. The reference itself is never accepted. The policy is told only that the task metric has to beat the task’s reference by a fixed margin; the reference method, the margin, and metric values are not part of any prompt, objective, or tool description, and automated tests scan the episodes of the forecasting tasks to confirm it.
paragraphs.zh: 每个任务都有一个确定性参考预测器，该预测器根据同一轮次中的可见数据计算得出（表 10）。接受规则是：指标值必须比参考值高出固定的幅度（可以是加法或乘法），且该幅度在每次运行前就已针对每个任务固定不变。参考值本身绝不会被接受。策略仅被告知：任务的指标值必须比该任务的参考值高出固定的幅度；而参考方法、幅度以及指标值本身不会出现在任何提示、目标或工具描述中，自动化测试也会扫描预测任务的各轮次数据以验证这一点。

paragraphs.en: Where a task has an official scorer, the evaluator calls or reproduces it: FoR30 uses the PhenoBench evaluator at a pinned commit, FoR42 the official sepsis-score script, FoR47 the CoNLL 2018 rules for valid trees, FoR48 the ContractNLI scorer (the implementation of precision at recall 80% agrees exactly with the official function in its tests), and FoR35 reproduces the published seasonal-naive MASE of the Monash archive (1.631) in its tests. FoR44 is cross-checked against the data team’s R outputs (the OLS coefficient equals R’s lm within 10 − 8 10^{-8} , and the true effect and response standard deviation are identical).
paragraphs.zh: 如果某项任务有官方评分器，评估器会调用或复现该评分器：FoR30 使用 PhenoBench 评估器的某个固定提交版本；FoR42 使用官方脓毒症评分脚本；FoR47 使用 CoNLL 2018 的有效树规则；FoR48 使用 ContractNLI 评分器（其在召回率 80% 时的精确度实现与官方函数在测试中的结果完全一致）；而 FoR35 则在测试中复现了 Monash 档案库已发表的、未考虑季节因素的 MASE 值（1.631）。FoR44 则通过与数据团队的 R 输出结果进行交叉验证（OLS 系数与 R 的 lm 结果在 10^{-8} 范围内相等，且真实效应和响应标准差完全一致）。

paragraphs.en: A held-out episode never drops out of a pooled metric. An episode whose solve produced no output, an invalid output, or a crashed evaluator contributes the adapter’s reference payload, so it counts as reference level, never better, with z = 0 z=0 , and it is flagged in the records. Coverage is checked against the episodes the split promises, and an incomplete discipline is excluded from a comparison rather than compared on different episode sets. An infrastructure failure, such as a gateway outage, is not a task failure: it is logged and the episode is retried at the next evaluation run.
paragraphs.zh: 预留的剧集绝不会从汇总指标中脱落。若某次解决过程未产生任何输出、产生无效输出，或评估器崩溃，则该剧集将贡献适配器的参考负载，因此被视为参考级别，且绝不会优于参考水平（z = 0 z=0），并在记录中标记出来。覆盖率将根据拆分所承诺的剧集进行检查；若学科不完整，则会在比较中被排除，而非基于不同的剧集集进行比较。基础设施故障（如网关中断）不属于任务失败：此类故障会被记录，并在下一次评估运行中重试该剧集。

Every episode exposes the same four generic tools: load_eval_inputs returns the 16 evaluation items without labels, load_train returns labelled examples drawn from the source role of the episode, load_dev_inputs returns further unlabelled items, and score_dev returns the visible development signal and the score of the reference predictor on it. The columns of the table list only what is specific to a discipline. The toolkit entries are modules of the shared library whose description is appended to the episode objective.

paragraphs.en: Two design choices apply across the cards. First, the data a policy sees are those of the source role: the held-out evaluation items never appear in load_train . Second, tool outputs that would reveal the answer are removed or anonymized, for example the series identity of FoR38 and the target answers of FoR39, which the query tool never reveals.
paragraphs.zh: 所有卡片都采用了两种设计选择。首先，策略所能看到的数据来自源角色：预留的评估项绝不会出现在 load_train 中。其次，可能暴露答案的工具输出会被移除或匿名化处理，例如 FoR38 的系列身份以及 FoR39 的目标答案，这些内容查询工具绝不会透露。

paragraphs.en: The policy sees an opaque handle and the inputs of each item, never a label, date, or lineage identifier. Training and development data come from the source roles only and are disjoint from every evaluated item; the visible development score is computed on a development slice carved from visible data.
paragraphs.zh: 该策略仅能看到不透明的句柄以及每个项目的输入，而永远看不到标签、日期或谱系标识符。训练数据和开发数据仅来自源角色，并且与所有被评估的项目相互独立；可见的开发分数则是基于从可见数据中划分出的开发切片计算得出的。

paragraphs.en: Items of one episode are scored together and all of their inputs are visible, so an item’s input must not be a near-future observation of another item’s label. Forecasting adapters enforce a minimum spacing when an episode is drawn: FoR37 episodes are lanes of 16 initializations at least 120 hours apart, and FoR33 windows of one building are at least 144 hours apart.
paragraphs.zh: 同一集内的项目会一起评分，且它们的所有输入都是可见的，因此一个项目的输入不能是另一个项目标签的近未来观测结果。预测适配器在抽取剧集时会强制执行最小间隔要求：FoR37 剧集由至少相隔 120 小时的 16 个初始化组成，而 FoR33 单个建筑的窗口则至少相隔 144 小时。

paragraphs.en: FoR42 checks causality with a hidden probe on prefixes of the stay in addition to a visible check against positional-only outputs, and FoR39 takes the query budget from signed receipts of the whole solve, failing closed when they are missing. In FoR38 economy identifiers, series kinds, and periods are opaque.
paragraphs.zh: FoR42 通过隐藏探针检查“停留”前缀的因果性，并同时对仅依赖位置信息的输出进行显式检查；而 FoR39 则从整个求解过程的带符号收据中获取查询预算，若收据缺失则执行失败处理。在 FoR38 中，经济标识符、序列类型和周期均为不透明的。

paragraphs.en: Generated code is scanned and runs in a separate process with a scrubbed environment (Appendix B.2 ). Hidden labels live inside the evaluator and never in the run directory.
paragraphs.zh: 生成的代码会在一个经过清理的环境中以独立进程的形式被扫描和运行（附录 B.2）。隐藏标签存在于评估器内部，绝不会出现在运行目录中。

paragraphs.en: Each discipline was assigned three PhD reviewers, and one expert from the natural or social sciences audited every evaluator and its reference executions across disciplines. The reviewers read the task card and the evaluator, ran the reference predictor, and checked the metric direction and unit, the acceptance margin, the hard constraints, and the leakage controls (Appendix C.6 ). When two reviewers disagreed, the cross-field expert read both reasons and the code involved and decided. A defect was fixed in the adapter or in the acceptance rule, and an unfixable property of a source benchmark was recorded in the task card.
paragraphs.zh: 每个学科都分配了三名博士评审员，并由一名来自自然科学或社会科学领域的专家对每位评估员及其跨学科参考执行进行了审核。评审员阅读了任务卡和评估员文档，运行了参考预测器，并检查了指标的方向和单位、接受范围、硬性约束以及数据泄露控制措施（附录 C.6）。当两名评审员的意见不一致时，跨领域专家会阅读双方的理由及相关的代码，并作出最终决定。适配器或接受规则中的缺陷会被修复，而源基准中无法修复的特性则会被记录在任务卡中。

paragraphs.en: In four disciplines (FoR31, 38, 46, and 48), the PhD reviewers also judged ten run records on source tasks each (five evaluator passes and five fails), and Table 13 compares their verdicts with those of the evaluator. The two agree on 37 of the 40 records (92.5%), with no missed detection (an evaluator pass that the reviewers reject) and three false rejections (an evaluator fail that the reviewers accept), and each false rejection lies at the acceptance boundary of its metric. Tables 15 and 16 list every verdict with its reason.
paragraphs.zh: 在四个学科领域（FoR31、38、46 和 48）中，博士论文评审员还分别对十个源任务的运行记录进行了评判（五个评审员判定为通过，五个判定为未通过），表 13 将这些评判结果与评审员的判定进行了比较。在 40 个记录中，两者的判定有 37 个一致（92.5%），没有出现漏检情况（即评审员拒绝而评审员判定的通过记录），但存在三次误判拒绝（即评审员接受而评审员判定的未通过记录），且每次误判拒绝都恰好处于其指标所设定的接受边界上。表 15 和表 16 列出了所有判定及其理由。

paragraphs.en: The policy forecasts the next 24 months of 16 tourism series in the native unit of each series. The reference predictor is the seasonal-naive forecast, and an instance is accepted if its MASE is at most 0.95 0.95 times that of the reference. The hard constraints require a finite, non-negative forecast of the right shape, with a scale guard against unit errors. Table 17 lists the held-out MASE of every system, and ScienceClaw is lowest on both splits.
paragraphs.zh: 该策略以每个序列的原生单位预测未来24个月中16个旅游系列的数据。参考预测模型为季节性朴素预测法，若实例的MASE值不超过参考模型MASE值的0.95倍，则该实例会被接受。硬性约束要求预测结果必须有限、非负且具备正确的形状，同时需通过尺度保护来防止单位误差的影响。表17列出了每个系统在验证集上的MASE值，ScienceClaw在两个分割数据集上的表现均为最优。

paragraphs.en: The policy scores every span of a contract against a hypothesis. The reference predictor combines lexical overlap with the majority label, and an instance is accepted if its mAP exceeds the reference by 0.10 0.10 . The hard constraints require one finite score in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] per span and valid labels. Table 17 lists the held-out mAP of every system, and ScienceClaw is highest on both splits.
paragraphs.zh: 该策略根据假设对合同的每个片段进行评分。参考预测器将词汇重叠与多数标签相结合，如果实例的 mAP 比参考值高 0.10 0.10，则该实例被接受。硬性约束要求每个片段在 [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] 范围内有一个有限分数，并且标签必须有效。表 17 列出了每个系统在预留数据集上的 mAP，ScienceClaw 在两个分割集上的表现均为最高。

paragraphs.en: A task of ScienceClaw-Eval is a computational task whose output can be scored by an executable evaluator inside a sandbox: a structured prediction, a forecast, a segmentation, a program, a parse, or a set of labels, together with the trace that produced it. The 23 tasks span the 23 disciplines of the field-of-research classification used in the main text, and each is built from a published benchmark with an official or reconstructed scorer (Table 10 ). A task enters the framework through D t = ( D T , t , D V , t , D E , t ) D_{t}=(D_{T,t},D_{V,t},D_{E,t}) and requires an evaluator that checks a replayed output against D V , t D_{V,t} .
paragraphs.zh: ScienceClaw-Eval 的一项任务是一种计算任务，其输出可以通过沙盒内的可执行评估器进行评分：结构化预测、预测结果、分割结果、程序、解析结果或一组标签，以及生成该输出的过程记录。这 23 项任务涵盖了正文中使用的研究领域分类中的 23 个学科，每一项任务都基于一个已发表的基准测试构建，并配有官方或重构的评估器（表 10）。一项任务通过 D t = ( D T , t , D V , t , D E , t ) D_{t}=(D_{T,t},D_{V,t},D_{E,t}) 进入该框架，并要求一个评估器来检查重播的输出是否与 D V , t D_{V,t} 一致。

paragraphs.en: An evaluator decides acceptance from the metric of an instance against a reference predictor, from hard constraints on the output, and from the failure semantics of the run. Three layers narrow the gap between acceptance and validity. The hard constraints catch the silent errors that a metric hides, such as a unit error, a forecast in the wrong scale, or a positional answer (Table 11 ). The leakage controls remove tool outputs that would reveal an answer (Appendix C.6 ). The acceptance rules require a policy to exceed a reference predictor by a stated margin (Table 10 ). The human audit of the evaluators is described in Appendix D .
paragraphs.zh: 评估器基于实例在指标上与参考预测器的对比、对输出的硬性约束，以及运行过程中的失败语义来决定是否接受结果。三个层级缩小了接受结果与结果有效性之间的差距。硬性约束能够捕捉到指标所掩盖的隐性错误，例如单位错误、尺度错误的预测或位置性答案（表11）。泄露控制机制则会移除可能暴露答案的工具输出（附录C.6）。接受规则要求策略必须比参考预测器高出规定的幅度（表10）。对评估器的人工审核在附录D中进行了描述。

paragraphs.en: The gate is strict by design (Appendix A.3 ). Of the 161 candidates of ScienceClaw, 70 were promoted ( 43.48 % 43.48\% ) and 91 were rejected. Table 19 lists the change of the OOD macro score per round. The score rises in six of seven rounds and falls only in round 3, by 0.20 0.20 pp.
paragraphs.zh: 该机制的设计本身即具有严格性（附录 A.3）。在 ScienceClaw 的 161 名候选人中，有 70 人通过（43.48% 43.48\%），91 人被拒绝。表 19 列出了每轮 OOD 宏观分数的变化。在七轮中有六轮的分数有所上升，仅在第 3 轮下降了 0.20 个百分点（0.20 pp）。

paragraphs.en: In the seven rounds of the benchmark, each of the last three rounds still adds between 1.43 1.43 and 2.24 2.24 pp. The components of the gate matter for the final score. Removing source replay, the scientific constraints, or the independent validator lowers the score of the full system by 6.18 6.18 , 7.33 7.33 , and 5.68 5.68 percent on average over the two splits, and removing the IID selection by 11.64 11.64 percent, against 13.68 13.68 percent for the frozen agent (Table 22 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在基准测试的七轮中，最后三轮每一轮仍分别增加了 1.43–1.43 和 2.24–2.24 个百分点。门组件对最终得分至关重要。移除源重播、科学约束或独立验证器后，完整系统的得分在两个分割数据集上的平均降幅分别为 6.18%、7.33% 和 5.68%；而移除 IID 选择则导致得分下降 11.64%，相比之下，冻结智能体的得分下降了 13.68%（表 22）。

paragraphs.en: Every system of the benchmark uses the same foundation model for orchestration: Qwen3.5-27B with open weights, served by a self-hosted inference server with thinking disabled and temperature 0 (Table 5 ). The zero-shot reference is the Frozen agent, which runs the initial program A 0 A_{0} with this model. Its OOD macro score is 77.72 % 77.72\% (Table 24 ), and ScienceClaw reaches 91.30 % 91.30\% after seven rounds.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试中的每个系统都使用相同的基座模型进行编排：Qwen3.5-27B（开放权重），由自托管的推理服务器提供服务，其中推理功能已禁用，温度设为 0（表 5）。零样本参考是 Frozen 智能体，它使用该模型运行初始程序 A 0 A_{0}。其 OOD 宏观得分为 77.72%（77.72\%）（表 24），而 ScienceClaw 在七轮后达到了 91.30%（91.30\%）。

paragraphs.en: Evolution uses GPT-5.4 in the main configuration (Table 5 ). The Qwen-only variant runs evolution on the orchestrator model instead. It retains 43.8 % 43.8\% of the gain of the full system (Table 22 ), and it is better than the frozen agent in 44 of the 46 discipline–split cells; the exceptions are FoR40 and FoR44 on OOD. A stronger evolution model therefore raises the quality of the candidates, while the gate and the replay set are the same for both models. Every baseline also runs its evolution calls on GPT-5.4 (Appendix B.8 ), so the Qwen-only variant is the one comparison in which the evolution model differs from that of the other evolving methods.
paragraphs.zh: Evolution 在主要配置（表 5）中使用了 GPT-5.4。而仅使用 Qwen 的变体则是在编排模型上运行进化过程。它保留了完整系统增益的 43.8 % 43.8\%（表 22），并且在 46 个学科分割单元格中的 44 个中表现优于冻结智能体；例外情况是 OOD 上的 FoR40 和 FoR44。因此，更强的进化模型提升了候选体的质量，而门控和重播集在这两种模型中是相同的。所有基线方法也都将其进化调用运行在 GPT-5.4 上（附录 B.8），因此仅使用 Qwen 的变体是唯一一个进化模型与其他进化方法不同的比较。

paragraphs.en: Every discipline contributes 64 instances to each of the ID and OOD splits (16 items in each of four episodes; Table 8 ). The MacroSR over the 23 disciplines is a mean over these instances, and Proposition A.20 bounds its standard error by 1.30 1.30 pp at n = 64 n=64 per discipline, and the standard error of a difference of two methods on independent draws by 1.84 1.84 pp. The margins of ScienceClaw over the strongest baseline in a discipline range from 1.82 1.82 to 3.73 3.73 percent (ID) and from 3.05 3.05 to 6.21 6.21 percent (OOD) on relative scale (Table 23 ), and the margin over the frozen agent ranges from 7.96 7.96 to 16.45 16.45 (ID) and from 11.57 11.57 to 23.34 23.34 (OOD).
paragraphs.zh: 每个学科都为 ID 和 OOD 分割各贡献了 64 个实例（每四个阶段各有 16 项；见表 8）。跨 23 个学科的 MacroSR 是这些实例的平均值，命题 A.20 将其标准误差限制在 n = 64（每个学科）时为 1.30 个百分点，而在独立抽样下两种方法差异的标准误差则为 1.84 个百分点。ScienceClaw 在该学科中最强基线模型上的优势范围在相对尺度上为 1.82% 至 3.73%（ID）以及 3.05% 至 6.21%（OOD）（见表 23），而相对于冻结智能体的优势范围则为 7.96% 至 16.45%（ID）以及 11.57% 至 23.34%（OOD）。

Each discipline contributes 64 IID and 64 OOD instances to every number in this appendix.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录报告了第 6 节中的图表所依据的各学科数据：相对余量、两种分割下的全部十八种变体，以及持续演化、迁移、可靠性和工作流程的测量结果。每个学科为本附录中的每一个数值贡献了 64 个 IID 实例和 64 个 OOD 实例。

paragraphs.en: Table 23 gives the relative margin of ScienceClaw over the frozen agent and over the strongest baseline in every discipline and split, computed from the scores shown in Table 1 . ScienceClaw leads the frozen agent in all 23 disciplines on both splits, and its margin over the strongest baseline is positive in every discipline: it ranges from 1.82% to 3.73% on IID and from 3.05% to 6.21% on OOD. EvoMaster or EvoScientist is the strongest baseline in most rows, which matches the order of the baselines by how much of the program they evolve (Section 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 表23给出了ScienceClaw在每一门学科和每个数据划分中相对于冻结智能体以及最强基线模型的相对优势，该优势基于表1中的得分计算得出。在所有23门学科的两个数据划分中，ScienceClaw均优于冻结智能体，并且它在每门学科中相对于最强基线模型的优势均为正值：在IID上的优势范围从1.82%到3.73%，在OOD上的优势范围从3.05%到6.21%。大多数行中，EvoMaster或EvoScientist是最强的基线模型，这与基线模型根据其所演化程序量的排序一致（第6节）。

paragraphs.en: Table 22 summarizes every variant by its relative drop below the full system and by the share of the full system’s gain over the frozen agent that it retains. Figures 7 and 8 show the task-native scores of all eighteen variants in each discipline, shaded within each discipline from the worst to the best variant, and Tables 28 – 30 list the same scores with the best and second best marked. The full system is the best variant in all 23 disciplines on both IID and OOD. The loss of every ablated variant is larger on OOD than on IID, in particular for the gate components: removing source replay, the scientific constraints, or the independent validator increases the drop 2.4 to 2.8 times from IID to OOD, and removing OOD transfer, which targets the OOD split, leaves IID nearly unchanged (a drop of 0.91%) while raising the OOD drop to 13.09%.
